rationale: Attack-surface hardening fuzz slice: libFuzzer targets for the host-facing plugin state blob, a ui.js document through the widget bridge in a QuickJS realm, SVG ingest, Standard MIDI File import and the content-pack manifests, each with a seed corpus and a bounded ctest smoke, plus a real-TLS negative control in the http test, a single-open WAV decode-limit check (read_audio_file admits the header on the reader that decodes), and a View guard that refuses a child which is itself or an ancestor (a ui.js naming a widget as its own parent used to hang the UI thread). The visual-proof-harness touch is test registration in view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake and checked-in fuzz seed fixtures; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves, and nothing runs on the per-PR required gate.
